chain.label: Cabin air conditioning flow control valve closed (cause undetermined)
chain.trigger: the condition of the flow control valve indicated that it was in its fully closed position at impact

chain.label: Flight crew became hypoxic and incapacitated
chain.trigger: the flight crewmembers became incapacitated at some point during the 6 minutes and 20 seconds between 0927:18 and 0933:38

caused_by.evidence: This closed valve would have prevented bleed air from entering the cabin, thereby preventing normal pressurization...it appears that the partial pressure of oxygen in the cabin after the depressurization was insufficient for the flight crew to maintain consciousness and that the flight crewmembers did not receive any, or adequate, supplemental oxygen

chain.label: Airplane flew off course and climbed uncontrolled to 48,900 feet
chain.trigger: the flight continued...deviated from its assigned course and failed to level at its assigned altitude (FL 390)

caused_by.evidence: There was no evidence that the flight crew attempted to intervene over the next 4 hours, as the airplane continued to fly off course, ascending to 48,900 feet, and finally descended to impact

chain.label: Fuel exhausted after prolonged unattended flight
chain.trigger: the airplane's final descent was initiated by an engine ceasing to operate

caused_by.evidence: Considering the length of time that the airplane had been flying, this was most likely caused by fuel exhaustion

chain.label: Engine ceased operating (flamed out)
chain.trigger: the sound of an engine winding down...can be heard on N47BA's cockpit voice recorder

caused_by.evidence: Wreckage examination also indicated that the right engine was not operating at impact

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall following engine spooldown
chain.trigger: followed by sounds similar to a stickshaker and an autopilot disconnect

caused_by.evidence: The CVR further indicated that engine spooldown was followed by aerodynamic stall and disengagement of the autopilot

chain.label: Airplane departed controlled flight and entered a descending spiral with aileron rolls
chain.trigger: the military pilots observed the airplane depart controlled flight and spiral to the ground

caused_by.evidence: the target is descending and he is doing multiple aileron rolls, looks like he's out of control...in a severe descent

chain.label: Airplane impacted open field near Aberdeen, South Dakota

caused_by.evidence: It's soon to impact the ground he is in a descending spiral

chain.label: All six occupants killed, airplane destroyed
chain.trigger: All occupants on board the airplane...were killed, and the airplane was destroyed

caused_by.evidence: All occupants on board the airplane (the captain, first officer, and four passengers) were killed, and the airplane was destroyed
